newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed on Thursday in featureless trade with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. May retail sales and weekly jobless claims figures, dealers said.
U.S. retail sales for May are forecast to show an increase of 0.4 percent compared with a 0.3 percent decline in April.
Weekly jobless claims for the week ended June 7 are expected to be around 326,000 against the previous week's 337,000.
"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning with most traders sidelined on lack of fresh factors," a dealer said.

"Some people are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from tonight's release of the retail sales and weekly jobless claims figures. But unless the numbers are way off market expectations, I don't think there will be much impact," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Thursday/Friday, weekend and week-fixed were unchanged from Wednesday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-3/16 6-1/16 percent. - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
